note: Complete. All six stages measured from Strava.

banner.title: He's home — 57 hours, 37 minutes
banner.body: Six stages, 216 miles, 32,717 feet, two nights, one continuous clock. Gold Dust — the sixth and last — was the fastest riding of the whole effort: four and a half hours, after fifty-three hours on the course. Thanks to everyone who watched the dot.
